Preference.app:title: Set Ringtone
Preference.app:summary: this is the tone that will play when you are receiving incoming voice or video call

CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Auto Enable bluetooth
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: enable or disable bluechat from turning on bluetooth when launched

CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Auto Disable bluetooth
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: enable or disable bluechat from turning off bluetooth when exited

CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Disable if Enabled
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: bluechat will only close bluetooth if it was opened by it

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Auto Listen for Incoming Connections
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: if off you will always be offline when the app start you have to manually enable active mode by tapping the eye icon at the tool bar

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Multiple connections
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: this enable you to connect to multiple devices or to allow multiple devices to connect to you\nThis is not recommended as multiple connections can decrease performance and increase battery consuption

EditTextPreference.app:title: Max Number of Connections
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Specify how many devices that can be connected to you at a time

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Disconnect On Call
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: when in voice or video call disconnect all other connected devices\nthis is recommended to increase performance as bluetooth calling is a heavy operation

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Dont Scan While Connected
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: bluetooth scanning is a heavy, if enabled bluechat wont scan for available devices if you are currently connected to a device

CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Never Show Alert
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: if enabled bluechat will never alert you for any information\nthis is not recommended as alerts are neccessary to notify you about important information

Preference.app:title: Blocked Devices
Preference.app:summary: tap to see the list of devices you blocked
